thread:
Jana: flagging a contract ask from Beacon Health — they want an option that avoids hard 429s during nightly scoring jobs. Asking for a customer-facing softcap option + billing model.

Alec: beacon numbers: baseline 800k tokens/day, nightly scoring peaks ~4M for 1-3 hours. They prefer hosted but could buy Dedicated if pricing makes sense.

Sam: clarifying Qs: are the job windows fixed? what traffic shape? also, do they need per-project toggles or org-level?

Alec: windows are predictable (23:00-02:00 local), same project triggers it. Org-level toggle is fine but sales would like per-project for quoting.

Maria: product options to consider: prepaid burst packs (SKU: Burst-100k), on-demand overage at premium, or "degrade to best-effort" softcap that queues + throttles instead of hard rejects. Each has tradeoffs.

Priya: finance viewpoint: prepaid packs are easiest for forecasting. On-demand should be ~1.4-1.6x token price to cover variable infra. Need invoice line items and preview in console.

Ryan: legal: "softcap" must be unambiguous. Draft language: "Softcap entitles customer to best-effort handling of burst traffic; Redwood may limit throughput to preserve platform stability; no uptime credits for softcap handling." Will iterate.

Nora (Eng): infra notes: current rate-limiter enforces hard org quotas. Implementing softcap will require a queueing shim, per-org fairness, and a billing hook to consume burst credits first. Also need circuit-breakers to avoid noisy neighbor impact.

Sam: rough engineering plan: (1) feature flag + queue shim, (2) billing hook + invoice line, (3) console toggle + preview. Estimate 4 sprints total, 3 engineers + infra support, can do an alpha in ~5 weeks.

billing-bot: internal refs: https://intranet/redwood/billing/metrics and SKU catalog: https://intranet/redwood/billing/skus

Maria: proposed alpha launch criteria: admin toggle in console, bill preview modal, on/off opt-in clause in contract, telemetry for p95 token latency and queue depth, and pilot with 3 customers max.

Priya: pricing proposal: (A) prepaid Burst Packs (tiered discounts at 500k, 2M, 10M tokens), (B) on-demand bursts at 1.5x standard token rate. I'll model Beacon's expected spend if Sam shares uplift estimate.

Sam: I'll run load tests with queued degrade mode and measure GPU seconds/token uplift. Expect ~20-35% extra GPU usage during bursts depending on batching efficiency. Will post numbers by EOW.

Alec: sales asks: must be able to toggle per-account and per-project, need a simple SKU to quote, and require an escalation path (SE + oncall) if pilot sees errors.

Ryan: legal ask: add a short amendment template for pilots that calls out opt-in, billing, and that Dedicated is required for SLA-backed promises.

Jana: decision proposal for this thread: (1) Ship "Burst Packs" prepaid SKU as primary product; (2) Offer Hosted softcap beta (feature-flagged, opt-in) that uses credits first then degrades throughput; (3) Provide Dedicated reserved buffer as a paid SLA for hard guarantees; (4) Gate GA on telemetry proving fairness and stable p95 behavior.

Maria: I'll add this to the roadmap milestone and prepare pilot onboarding UX.

Priya: once Sam posts uplift numbers I'll finalize price points and discount bands.

Sam: ack, starting tests today. Will add runbook and synthetic batch tests to the eng doc.

Alec: I'll get Beacon to sign a pilot LOI if we can show a bill preview and toggle in the admin console.

Nora: risk callouts: KV cache pressure for long sequences, memory spikes, and concurrent pilot bursts causing cross-tenant latency. Recommend per-org circuit breakers and memory soft-limits.

Jana: next steps: Sam (POC + uplift estimate by EOW), Ryan (pilot amendment draft in 3 business days), Priya (pricing skeleton after uplift), Maria (console copy + onboarding), Alec (secure pilot). We'll triage after POC results.

Alec: thanks everyone — I'll coordinate with Beacon.

Jana: thanks team, we'll reconvene Thursday for a short go/no-go after POC metrics are in.
